tagline: Draw a card. Talk in English. Decide who nailed it.
randomDesc: The colors shuffled into one deck. Pickup Lines stay out.
themedDesc: Pick one color and stay in its mood.
endText: Count the points, or just argue about who told the best story.
hint: Drag the card off the screen to draw the next one
lead: Spill is a conversation game. Nobody really wins. The goal is to talk in English about things you would never bring up on your own.

steps.t: Random mixes the decks, except Pickup Lines, which only play in Themed. Themed keeps one color, so the whole round shares a mood.
Answer it in English and talk for about a minute.
Everyone can ask follow-up questions or jump in with their own story.
When the topic runs out, drag the card off the screen and pass the turn.

pointsText: After each answer, the group gives one point to the most creative or interesting one. The best compliment in Spill is “Okay, you got me on that one.”
note: Mistakes are part of the game. Nobody stops a story to fix grammar.
tagline2: A conversation game for two or more players.
